translation: 或者，摧毀所有外星艦船

source: Oh no! Ours planet seems to be lost!
translation: 不！我們的行星似乎已經淪陷了！

source: Okay, now some real action. See those holograms projected by our ships? Send your Squadron to destroy them.
translation: 好，來點真實的戰鬥練習。看到我方艦船投影出的全像目標了嗎？派中隊摧毀它們。

source: Opens the Research Tree, where you unlock new modules and upgrades for your fleet.
translation: 開啟研究樹，為艦隊解鎖新模組與升級。

source: Or you can press {bindings} on keyboard to rotate the camera.
translation: 也可以按鍵盤上的 {bindings} 旋轉視角。

source: Order selected cargo-capable units to collect debris or cargo.
translation: 命令所選具載貨能力的單位收集殘骸物資或貨物。

source: Order selected cargo-capable units to unload cargo to a target ship.
translation: 命令所選具載貨能力的單位將貨物卸至目標船艦。

source: Order selected miners to mine an asteroid.
translation: 命令所選採礦船開採小行星。

source: Order selected ships to ram an enemy target.
translation: 命令所選船艦撞擊敵方目標。

source: Order selected squadrons or raptors to return to their hangar.
translation: 命令所選中隊或猛禽機返回機庫。

source: Order selected units to defend a target ship.
translation: 命令所選單位護衛目標船艦。

source: Order selected units to move to a location. Hold Shift to queue the order.
translation: 命令所選單位前往指定位置。按住 Shift 可將命令加入佇列。

source: Order selected units to move toward a location and attack enemies they encounter.
translation: 命令所選單位前往指定位置，並攻擊沿途遭遇的敵人。

source: Our Attack Squadron and Miner are still docked. Release them, Commander.
translation: 攻擊中隊與採礦船還停在機庫裡。指揮官，讓它們出動。

source: Our ammo storage is full, Commander. Mining Ships will leave any resources we can’t store outside the fleet as cargo.
translation: 指揮官，彈藥庫已滿。採礦船會將無法存放的資源以貨物形式留在艦隊外。

source: Our offensive ships are destroyed! We are stuck here forever!
translation: 我們的攻擊艦全被摧毀了！這下永遠也離不開這裡了！

source: Our radars detected a point of interest. See that red exclamation mark? It could mean hostile threats or a wreck worth salvaging. Let’s investigate.
translation: 雷達偵測到值得調查的目標。看到那個紅色驚嘆號了嗎？它可能代表敵方威脅，也可能是值得回收的殘骸。去調查吧。

source: Our ships are vulnerable out in the open. Command them back to the hangar to keep them safe.
translation: 小型艦船在外面太容易受到攻擊。命令它們返回機庫，確保安全。

source: Own {targetMetal} Metal for Storage module. In storage: {amountMetal} Metal.
translation: 準備倉儲模組所需的 {targetMetal} 金屬。目前庫存：{amountMetal} 金屬。

source: Own {targetMetal} Metal for Supply Hold module. In storage: {amountMetal} Metal.
translation: 準備補給艙模組所需的 {targetMetal} 金屬。目前庫存：{amountMetal} 金屬。
艦船狀態完整 - 艦船生命值 100%

source: Place Farm module anywhere on any ship in your fleet.
translation: 在艦隊任一艘艦船上放置農場模組。

source: Place Farm module anywhere on ship.
translation: 在艦船上放置農場模組。

source: Place Flak module  on ship with farm modules.
translation: 在裝有農場模組的艦船上放置防空砲模組。

source: Place Gauss Cannon module anywhere on ship with farm modules.
translation: 在裝有農場模組的艦船上放置高斯砲模組。

source: Place Recycling Station module anywhere on any ship.
translation: 在任一艘艦船上放置回收站模組。

source: Place Recycling Station module anywhere on ship.
translation: 在艦船上放置回收站模組。

source: Press Pause button in UI panel or spacebar to pause game.
translation: 點擊介面上的暫停按鈕，或按空白鍵暫停遊戲。

source: Press Play button in UI panel or spacebar to unpause game.
translation: 點擊介面上的播放按鈕，或按空白鍵繼續遊戲。

source: Press and hold {bindings} mouse, to rotate the camera with mouse.
translation: 按住 {bindings} 滑鼠按鍵，移動滑鼠即可旋轉視角。

source: Press undock button to launch the Miner and Squadron ships from your capital ship.
translation: 點擊出動按鈕，讓採礦船與中隊從主力艦出動。
按 {bindings} 將視角重設為預設位置。

source: Prevents the spread of disease and treats up to 10 sick people, providing a full recovery within 10 days.
translation: 防止疾病傳播，並同時治療最多 10 名病患，使其在 10 天內完全康復。

source: Prevents the spread of disease and treats up to 10 sick people, providing a full recovery within 5 days. Also contributes to research at 80% efficiency
translation: 防止疾病傳播，並同時治療最多 10 名病患，使其在 5 天內完全康復。另以 80% 效率提供研究產出。

source: Prevents the spread of disease and treats up to 25 sick people, providing a full recovery within 10 days.
translation: 防止疾病傳播，並同時治療最多 25 名病患，使其在 10 天內完全康復。

source: Produced by your people as they eat. Fills up storage and needs somewhere to go.
translation: 人們進食後產生的廢棄物，會占用儲存空間，必須妥善處理。

source: Raise HP of all Mining Ships and Attack Squadrons by 30%. Can be built once.
translation: 所有採礦船與攻擊中隊的生命值提高 30%。限建一座。

source: Raise Range of all Flak Cannons by 25%.
translation: 所有防空砲的射程提高 25%。

source: Raise max speed of all ships by 20%.
translation: 所有艦船的最高速度提高 20%。

source: Raises production of Goods in every Goods Factory by 20%. Can be built once.
translation: 所有商品工廠的商品產量提高 20%。限建一座。

source: Reduce Fuel Cost of FTL travel by 10%.
translation: FTL 航行的燃料消耗降低 10%。

source: Reduces consuption of Food by 10%. Can be built once.
translation: 食物消耗降低 10%。限建一座。

source: Remove selected squadrons from their current formation.
translation: 讓所選中隊脫離目前的編隊。

source: Repair current ship during FTL travel.
translation: 在 FTL 航行期間修復所在艦船。

source: Repairs all damaged ships in the fleet during FTL travel. Repair drones are deployed to 2 ships, sharing the bay’s total repair capacity.
translation: 在 FTL 航行期間修復艦隊中所有受損艦船。維修無人機會派往 2 艘艦船，共享維修艙的總修復能力。

source: Repairs all damaged ships in the fleet during FTL travel. Repair drones are deployed to 4 ships, sharing the bay’s total repair capacity.
translation: 在 FTL 航行期間修復艦隊中所有受損艦船。維修無人機會派往 4 艘艦船，共享維修艙的總修復能力。

source: Repairs all damaged ships in the fleet during FTL travel. Repair drones are deployed to each ship, sharing the bay’s total repair capacity.
translation: 在 FTL 航行期間修復艦隊中所有受損艦船。維修無人機會派往每艘艦船，共享維修艙的總修復能力。

source: Research the Metallurgy module in research tree ({currentResearch}).
translation: 在研究樹中研究冶金模組（{currentResearch}）。

source: Retrievable materials from destroyed ships or dropped storage.
translation: 可從毀損船艦或散落貨物中回收的物資。
蘊藏豐富資源的小行星。

source: Right click on projected enemy to destroy it.
translation: 以滑鼠右鍵點擊模擬敵軍，將其摧毀。

source: Right-click a capital ship with your Squadron to guard it.
translation: 選取中隊後，以滑鼠右鍵點擊主力艦，即可讓中隊護衛它。

source: Right-click anywhere to move the selected ship to new destination.
translation: 以滑鼠右鍵點擊目的地，命令選取的艦船移動。

source: Right-click on wreck to send Miner there to search.
translation: 以滑鼠右鍵點擊殘骸，派採礦船前往搜索。

source: Right-click on wreck to send it there.
translation: 以滑鼠右鍵點擊殘骸，命令艦船前往。

source: Right-click the decommissioned ship for ships to attack.
translation: 以滑鼠右鍵點擊退役船艦，命令我方船艦攻擊。

source: Right-click the projected enemy ships to attack.
translation: 以滑鼠右鍵點擊投影出的敵艦，發動攻擊。

source: Right-click the smaller asteroid for ships to attack.
translation: 以滑鼠右鍵點擊較小的小行星，命令艦船攻擊。

source: Run the simulation at double speed.
Run the simulation at normal speed.
Run the simulation at the fastest speed.
Saturates an area with flak fire, damaging enemy fighters and missiles inside it. Needs at least two flak cannons.
translation: 以密集防空火力覆蓋區域，傷害其中的敵方戰機與飛彈。至少需要兩門防空砲。

source: Save first ally ship by destroying its attacker with your Capital ships. Capital ship's gauss cannons are strong against Reactive Armor on enemy Frigate.
translation: 用主力艦摧毀攻擊者，救下第一艘友軍艦船。主力艦的高斯砲能有效對付敵方巡防艦的反應裝甲。
救援第一艘艦船（選擇性）

source: Save second ally ship  by destroying its attacker with your Corvette. Corvette's rockets are strong against Reflective Armor on enemy Light Destroyer.
translation: 用護衛艦摧毀攻擊者，救下第二艘友軍艦船。護衛艦的飛彈能有效對付敵方輕型驅逐艦的反射裝甲。
救援第二艘艦船（選擇性）
從殘骸中救出採礦船：{amountRaptor}/{targetRaptor}（選擇性）

source: Search nearby star systems for resources and a safe route forward. Our fleet’s survival depends on what you find.
translation: 搜索附近星系，尋找資源與安全的前進路線。艦隊能否生存，就取決於你的發現。

source: Search the lechu for lost coordinates that are inside Wrecks. {amountLechuCoordinates}/{targetLechuCoordinates}
translation: 搜索殘骸，找回失落的利丘座標。{amountLechuCoordinates}/{targetLechuCoordinates}

source: Secure the core and prepare the fleet to jump. We’ll study what we’ve found on the way. Whoever answered that signal, we’re not waiting here to meet them.
translation: 保護好核心，讓艦隊準備躍遷。路上再研究這些發現。不管是誰回應了訊號，我們都不會留在這裡等他們。

source: Select Miner and send it to search the other red exclamation mark.
translation: 選取採礦船，派它前往另一個紅色驚嘆號處調查。

source: Select Miner and send it to search the red exclamation mark.
translation: 選取採礦船，派它前往紅色驚嘆號處調查。

source: Select Miner and send it to the debris.
translation: 選取採礦船並派往散落物資處。
